title: self-review outcome
description: The outcome of a self-review (feature-self-review.md, feature-fix-self-review.md), its final message. The loop escalates when ok is false, and runs the test gate again when changed is true (F-68 D2).

summary.description: One line: what the self-review found and did.

ok.description: true when the branch can go to the independent review; false when it cannot and the self-review could not correct it.

changed.description: true when the self-review committed a correction.
